subtopics.title: Preference Finetuning Objectives
subtopics.summary: The goal of aligning model outputs with human preferences, the challenges of defining universal human preference mathematically, and the risks of over-censorship or misalignment.

subtopics.title: Preference Data Collection
subtopics.summary: The process of gathering human feedback to rank model outputs, creating datasets of preferred versus rejected responses for training.

subtopics.title: Preference Optimization Algorithms
subtopics.summary: Algorithms such as RLHF and DPO that optimize a model to generate responses matching human preferences based on ranked data.

subtopics.title: Domain Mix in Preference Finetuning
subtopics.summary: How the optimal distribution of training domains, such as general knowledge, math, and coding, shifts during preference finetuning compared to earlier stages.
